response.sql:
WITH project_counts AS (
  SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) AS qc_count
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY arcref
), shares AS (
  SELECT arcref, qc_count,
         CAST(qc_count AS REAL) / SUM(qc_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM project_counts
), deviations AS (
  SELECT arcref, qc_count, share,
         share - AVG(share) OVER () AS deviation
  FROM shares
)
SELECT arcref, qc_count, share, deviation
FROM deviations
ORDER BY deviation DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Projects with no QC records are excluded because the request says to count projects in the QC data; the average share is across projects with at least one QC record.

alternatives.interpretation: Include every project, treating projects without QC records as having a count and share of zero, and average shares across all projects.
alternatives.sql:
WITH project_counts AS (
  SELECT p.arcregistry AS arcref, COUNT(q.qualregistry) AS qc_count
  FROM projects AS p
  LEFT JOIN scanqc AS q ON q.arcref = p.arcregistry
  GROUP BY p.arcregistry
), shares AS (
  SELECT arcref, qc_count,
         CAST(qc_count AS REAL) / SUM(qc_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM project_counts
), deviations AS (
  SELECT arcref, qc_count, share,
         share - AVG(share) OVER () AS deviation
  FROM shares
)
SELECT arcref, qc_count, share, deviation
FROM deviations
ORDER BY deviation DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
